gitBlobComparison.explanation: The repository uses core.autocrlf=true and text=auto attributes. A fresh git archive of the exact commit reproduces the recorded archive byte-for-byte, including its CRLF text conversion. Binary fonts and all other content match.

verifiedChecks: Requires passed strict hardening with exit code zero and no failures, plus candidate HTTP, infrastructure, image, and PDF review gates.
